questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations. It involves optimizing your digital footprint so AI systems like ChatGPT, Google's Search Generative Experience, and Perplexity recognize your brand as authoritative, relevant, and trustworthy enough to cite [6]. Compared with AEO, GEO is broader and longer term, focused on making your brand a recognized entity that AI systems mention by name [5]. You can read more on the [FAQ page](/faq/).
